collection.title: BMW X6 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The BMW X6 2019 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button wiper arm attachment.

image.alt: BMW X6 2019 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
